text:
Hi HN, I made Recap Studio, a Mac app for recording demos and tutorials that look good without a video editor.

You record your screen, camera and mic. Then you can zoom in on parts of the video, smooth the cursor, add a background, show the keys you press, and cut out mistakes. The newest feature keeps your face centered in the camera as you move.
title: Show HN: Recap Studio – A Mac screen recorder for clean, polished demos
